items.summary: Remove the WorkflowSection component from the App.tsx composition and replace it with a new ReferralProgramSection component that displays the referral program information in Spanish

Create a new ReferralProgramSection component that presents the referral program with a heading 'Programa de Referencias' and explains the commission structure: 15-30% commission on the first contract obtained, 15% of the net value of the first contract collected from the referred client, payment after receiving full payment from the client, and transfer within 30 days after collection

Structure the ReferralProgramSection to highlight the commission details prominently using a card or grid layout similar to other sections, with icons or visual elements that convey partnership and financial benefits
